column2: 拉丁语 reciprocus（来回往复的），或出短语 reque proque（来来回回），由 re-（回）＋ prō（向前）构成
column3: given and received in return by both sides
column5: The two countries signed a reciprocal deal.|Their trust was entirely reciprocal.
column6: moving back and forth between two sides – 在两方之间来回往复的
column7: 相互的：双方彼此都做同一件事|互惠的：双方都从中得到好处

column2: 中古英语 recognicion ← 中古法语 recognition 及其来源 ← 拉丁语 recognitiōnem，源自 recognōscere（重新认出）
column3: the act of knowing someone or something from before, or public praise
column5: The system uses voice recognition now.|Her work finally received wide recognition.
column6: knowing again what was known before – 把先前知道的重新认出来
column7: 辨识：从特征上认出是谁或是什么|认可：公开承认其价值

column2: 借自中古法语 reconoistre ← 古法语 reconoistre ← 拉丁语 recognōscere，由 re-（再）＋ cognōscere（认识）构成
column3: to know someone or something because of previous experience
column5: I did not recognize her at first.|Few countries recognized the new government.
column6: coming to know again what one knew – 把认识过的重新认定
column7: 辨认：从外形或声音认定是何人何物|承认：正式认定其地位或事实

column2: 借自中世纪拉丁语 recollectus（重新聚起、想起），源自拉丁语 recolligere（再收拢）
column3: to remember something after trying to
column5: He could not recollect the exact date.|She recollected the summer in detail.
column6: gathering scattered memories back together – 把散开的记忆重新收拢
column7: 回想：努力把往事想出来|追忆：细细回想过去的情景

column2: 中古英语 recreacion ← 中古法语 recreacion ← 古法语 recreacion ← 拉丁语 recreātiō（恢复、重新造起）
column3: activity done for pleasure when not working
column5: The park provides recreation for the whole town.|Reading is his main recreation.
column6: making oneself over again after work – 做工之余把自己重新造一遍
column7: 娱乐：为快乐而做的活动|消遣：用来打发闲暇的事

column2: 借自法语 recruter（招募），源自 recrue（新长出的一批）
column3: a new member of a group, or to enlist new members
column5: The army trained forty recruits that spring.|They recruited two engineers last month.
column6: a fresh growth added to a body – 补进队伍的新一批
column7: 新兵：刚加入队伍的成员|招募：招收新成员进来

column2: 借自中古法语 ← 晚期拉丁语 rectangulum（直角），由拉丁语 rectus（直）＋ angulus（角）构成
column3: a flat shape with four straight sides and four right angles
column5: Draw a rectangle around the whole table.|The field is a long rectangle.
column6: a four-sided figure with all angles upright – 四角皆正的四边形
column7: 长方形：邻边不等的矩形|矩形：四个角都是直角的四边形

column2: 借自拉丁语 redundāns，为 redundāre（漫溢）的现在分词，由 red-（回）＋ unda（波）构成
column3: more than is needed, or no longer required
column5: The last paragraph is entirely redundant.|Two hundred workers were made redundant.
column6: flooding over past what is needed – 漫过了所需的量
column7: 多余的：超出需要因而不必要|冗余的：为备用而故意留出的重复

column2: 古法语 reflecter（折回）← 拉丁语 reflectere，由 re-（回）＋ flectere（弯）构成
column3: to throw back light or sound, or to think carefully
column5: Still water reflects the whole sky.|The figures reflect a real decline.
column6: bending something back the way it came – 把来的东西按原路弯回去
column7: 反射：光或声被弹回|反映：把实际情形显出来

column2: 中古英语 refleccioun ← 中古法语 reflexion 及其来源 ← 晚期拉丁语 reflexiō，源自 reflectere（折回）
column3: an image thrown back by a surface, or careful thought
column5: She studied her reflection in the glass.|After some reflection he changed his mind.
column6: what comes back after being bent – 折回来的那个东西
column7: 倒影：镜面或水面反回的影像|反思：把念头折回自身细想

column2: 中古英语 refreynen ← 古法语 refrener ← 拉丁语 refrēnāre（拉住缰绳），由 re-（回）＋ frēnum（马缰）构成
column3: to hold oneself back from doing something, or a repeated line in a song
column5: Please refrain from smoking in here.|The crowd sang the refrain twice.
column6: pulling back on the reins – 把缰绳往回拉住
column7: 忍住：克制自己不去做|副歌：歌中反复回来的那一段

column2: 中古英语 refuge ← 古法语 refuge ← 拉丁语 refugium（逃回之处），由 re-（回）＋ fugere（逃）构成
column3: a place giving protection from danger
column5: The cave offered refuge from the storm.|Thousands sought refuge across the border.
column6: a place one flees back into – 逃回去躲起来的地方
column7: 避难所：可躲避危险的处所|庇护：得到保护这件事

column2: 借自法语 réfugié，为 réfugier（避难）的过去分词 ← 古法语 refuge ← 拉丁语 refugium；最初指 1685 年南特敕令废除后出逃的法国胡格诺派教徒
column3: a person who has left home to escape danger
column5: The camp housed two thousand refugees.|She worked with refugees for years.
column6: one who has fled and taken shelter – 逃出来另寻庇护的人

column2: 中古英语 refunden ← 古法语 refondre ← 拉丁语 refundere（倒回），由 re-（回）＋ fundere（倒）构成
column3: money paid back, or to pay money back
column5: The shop gave her a full refund.|They refunded the fare without argument.
column6: pouring the money back to where it came – 把钱倒回原处
column7: 退款：退回去的那笔钱|退还：把已收的钱交回

column2: 借自拉丁语 refūtāre（驳回）
column3: to prove that something is wrong
column5: New data refuted the earlier claim.|He refuted every point in turn.
column6: beating a claim back – 把说法打回去
column7: 驳倒：用证据把对方说法彻底推翻|反驳：针对某说法提出相反理由

column2: 中古英语 regretten ← 古法语 regreter（哀悼），由 re-（加强）＋ *greter（哭）构成，后者出法兰克语 *grātan（哭、悼）
column3: to feel sorry about something done or not done
column5: She regretted sending that letter.|He regrets nothing about the decision.
column6: grieving back over what is past – 对已过之事回头哀惜
column7: 后悔：为自己做过的事感到不该|遗憾：为未能如愿感到可惜

column2: 中古英语 rehercel，由 rehearse ＋ -al 构成；rehearse ← 古法语 rehercier（再耙一遍）
column3: a practice session before a performance
column5: The final rehearsal ran until midnight.|Every rehearsal begins with the same scene.
column6: going over the ground again before the real thing – 正式上演前先把地再耙一遍

column2: 由 re-（再）＋ inforce（enforce 的旧式）构成；enforce ← 古法语 enforcier ← 拉丁语 fortis（强）
column3: to make something stronger, or to support an idea
column5: Steel bars reinforce the concrete beam.|The result reinforced their original view.
column6: putting more strength into something – 再往里加一份力
column7: 加固：使结构更结实|强化：使某种看法或效果更牢

column2: 借自拉丁语 reluctāns，为 reluctārī（挣扎抗拒）的现在分词，由 re-（回）＋ luctārī（角力）构成
column3: unwilling and slow to act
column5: She was reluctant to leave so early.|He gave a reluctant nod.
column6: struggling back against being moved – 被推动时往回挣的
column7: 勉强的：不情愿但还是做了|不愿的：心里就不想做

column2: 中古英语 remainen ← 古法语 remanoir 的重读词干 ← 拉丁语 remanēre（留住），由 re-（仍）＋ manēre（停留）构成
column3: to stay in the same place or condition
column5: Only two chairs remain in the room.|The question remains unanswered today.
column6: staying on where others have gone – 别的都走了还停在那儿
column7: 留下：仍处在原处未离开|仍是：状态没有改变

column2: 中古英语 remaindre ← 古法语 remaindre（经盎格鲁诺曼语传入）← 拉丁语 remanēre（留住），以不定式直接作名词用
column3: the part that is left after the rest is taken
column5: Divide nine by four and name the remainder.|She spent the remainder in silence.
column6: what stays behind when the rest goes – 其余取走后停留下来的那份
column7: 余数：除法算余下的数|其余：剩下未动的那一部分

column2: 由 remain ＋ -s 构成，作复数名词用；remain ← 古法语 remanoir ← 拉丁语 remanēre（留住）
column3: the parts of something that are left after the rest is gone
column5: Archaeologists uncovered Roman remains here.|The remains of supper sat on the table.
column6: the parts that stayed on – 留下来没消失的那些部分
column7: 遗迹：古时留存下来的实物痕迹|残余：整体消去后剩的部分

column2: 借自中古法语 remarquer ← 古法语 remarquer，由 re-（再）＋ marquer（标记）构成
column3: something said briefly, or to say something briefly
column5: His remark surprised everyone at the table.|She remarked on the sudden change.
column6: marking something out by saying it – 说出来把它标出
column7: 评论：就某事说出的看法|言辞：所说出的那句话

column2: 由 remark ＋ -able 构成 ← 法语 remarquable
column3: unusual enough to be worth noticing
column5: She made remarkable progress that term.|The building has a remarkable roof.
column6: worth marking out from the rest – 值得从其余里标出来的
column7: 显著的：明显到一眼看见|非凡的：远超一般水平

column2: 中古英语 remedie ← 古法语 remede ← 拉丁语 remedium（疗方），由 re-（再）＋ medērī（医治）构成
column3: a cure for an illness, or a way to fix a problem
column5: This herb is an old remedy.|The law provides no clear remedy.
column6: something applied to heal what is wrong – 拿来治好毛病的东西
column7: 疗法：治病的方子|补救办法：把问题纠正过来的办法

column2: 中古英语 remembren ← 古法语 remembrer ← 晚期拉丁语 rememorārī，由 re-（再）＋ memor（记着的）构成
column3: to keep something in mind or bring it back to mind
column5: She still remembers his phone number.|He remembered the address just in time.
column6: bringing back to mind what was held there – 把心里存着的重新提起
column7: 记得：一直存在心里没忘|回忆起：把已淡的往事重新想到

column2: 17 世纪中期起见于记载，由 re-（再）＋ mind（记起）构成，或受旧词 rememorate 影响
column3: to make someone think of something again
column5: Please remind me before the meeting.|The photo reminded her of home.
column6: putting something back into another mind – 把某事重新放进别人心里

column2: 中古英语 remenant 的缩合 ← 古法语 remaindre 的现在分词（经盎格鲁诺曼语 remanant）← 拉丁语 remanēre（留住）
column3: a small part left over after the rest is used
column5: A remnant of the wall still stands.|She sewed a bag from cloth remnants.
column6: the small part that stayed behind – 用去大半后留下的一小块
column7: 残余：整体消去后剩的一点|零头：裁用后余下的小块

column2: 中古英语 renderen ← 古法语 rendre（交还）← 晚期拉丁语 rendere ← 拉丁语 reddere（给回）
column3: to cause something to be in a certain state, or to produce an image
column5: The blow rendered him unconscious.|The software renders each frame separately.
column6: giving something back in a new form – 以新形态把东西交出来
column7: 使成为：让某物变成某种状态|渲染：把模型算成成品画面

column2: 借自法语 répertoire ← 中古法语 repertoire ← 晚期拉丁语 repertōrium（清单、目录）
column3: all the pieces a performer is ready to present
column5: The quartet has a wide repertoire.|Sarcasm was not in his repertoire.
column6: the listed stock one can draw on – 列在册上随时可取的一批
column7: 保留曲目：演出者练熟可随时上演的作品|全部本领：一个人能拿出来的全部手段
